summary: Jæren Sparebank engages in providing banking and financial services to personal and agricultural customers as well as small/medium-sized businesses in Norway. The company operates through Private Market and Corporate Market. It offers checking and savings accounts; pension accounts; deposits; and refinancing services. The company also provides loans that include mortgage, mortgages for young people, construction loan, fixed-rate loans, proof of financing, moving mortgage, green mortgage, framework loan, refinancing of mortgages, cottage loan, and other types loans, such as refinancing consumer debt, car loan, consumer loans, and loans for motorcycles, motorhomes, and boats. In addition, it offers insurance brokerage services for cars and other vehicles, house and belonging, life and health, and animal insurance. Further, the company provides credit and debit cards and mobile payment solutions. The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Bryne, Norway.
